A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] '''[[Seylott (species)|Seylott]]''' stole the [[Infant of Shaa]] from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ashaar Khorda]]. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was hired to recover the artifact. He tracked the Seylott to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seylott/Legends|Seylott]], where he confronted the native. After the Seylott refused to surrender the artifact, Fett shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.<ref name="Jango" />
